title: The old road over Khandala
excerpt: The expressway took the traffic and left the ghat to whoever wanted it. Which, on a weekday morning, is nobody.

title: What "rider-friendly" actually means
excerpt: Every listing site says it. Almost none of them mean a tap, a roof and a gate that opens at four in the morning.

title: Coast road to Kashid
excerpt: Thirty-two kilometres that take an hour if you do them right, and twenty minutes if you have missed the point entirely.

title: Riding the Sahyadris in July
excerpt: Everything is green, nothing is dry, and visibility is a rumour. On what to carry and when to turn back.

title: Two days to Goa, the slow way
excerpt: NH-48 gets you there by dinner. The Konkan coast road gets you there having been somewhere.
